title: CellPrior-net: Prior-guided nuclei detection and classification for H&E whole-slide images

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《CellPrior-net: Prior-guided nuclei detection and classification for H&E whole-slide images》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Accurate nuclei detection and classification in hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) whole-slide images (WSIs) is a key task in computational pathology, particularly for quantitative analysis of the tumor microenvironment.
